subject: How to tweak Fit summary (summary function)

messages.author: 63780e17e344f0aa
messages.subject: How to tweak Fit summary (summary function)
parts:
Hi,

I am using R x64 3.4.2 version and the latest lavaan package. However the summary of model fit for SEM is missing covariance detail. I am using the syntax : summary(fit2, fit.measures=TRUE, standardized=TRUE). Somehow it is yielding latent variable regression weights, variances and model fit indexes. The covariance among the dimensions are missing.
Can you tell me how to force R to show the covariance details?

Thanks in advance. I really appreciate the group members' contribution for beginners.


Diya

messages.author: ad188126f9138663
messages.subject: Re: How to tweak Fit summary (summary function)
parts:
Diya,
Don't tweak, supplement.

lavInspect(fit2, what='cov.lv')

The reason you do not get the covariances of the latent variables as part of the summary is that it is giving you parameter estimates but the covariances are apparently not parameters in your model.  If you replaced the latent variable regressions with covariances, then they would appear in the output (i.e., in an oblique CFA).  Presumably, you wish to retain the regressions, which replace the covariances with regression parameters in your model.  So, lavInspect() allows you to extract the implied covariances.

Keith
